brief: Long low one-storey machine shed of rough-coursed tan limestone about 60 ft by 22 ft under a shallow gable roof of dark weathered shingles. The left third is a vehicle bay with a wide white sliding plank door (one leaf open onto a dark interior); a section of the wall is patched with stacked squared timbers, then a white plank man door and a boarded window in the stone. Two corrugated steel grain bins with conical roofs rise just behind it; bare dirt yard and dry grass. (Stone walls; nearest vocabulary type is frame_machine_shed.)
